support_design.support_multiplier_units: pooled damaged-site events / fire-tick support floor; descriptive only
support_design.fire_count_semantics: tick incidence: one fired seed-tick regardless of the number of damaged sites created in that tick
support_design.fire_predicate: net increase in nnz of the condition's allowed chromosome field(s) during that DNADamage tick; in-place subtype conversion at an already-occupied site is not a fire
support_design.dose_units: synthetic radiation-substrate units; statistical mechanism-test scale, not a biological dose

no_stimulus.expected_role: quiescent negative control; never a zero-equals-zero PASS
no_stimulus.note: The fixture carries a negligible gamma value near 2.8e-11; this synthetic control intentionally sets both radiation gates to exact zero.

per_kind_support.claim_policy: Only reaction kinds with preregistered expected pooled site events >= 50 may receive a per-kind incidence verdict; all others are descriptive/NO_KARR_SUPPORT by construction.
No gamma reaction kind clears the per-kind support floor; all per-kind incidence is descriptive/NO_KARR_SUPPORT by construction.

rng_schedule.pairing: process seed 2000+i pairs with chromosome seed 3000+i for i=0..49

evidence_contract.numeric_threshold_source: Karr-only seed-cluster null; no fixed tolerance
exact_invariants: UVB writes only intrastrandCrossLinks; gamma writes only damagedBases or strandBreaks
all sparse positions/strands are in bounds

baseline_state_assumptions.polymerized_nt_formula: 2 * sequenceLen because the fixture chromosome ploidy is exactly 1
baseline_state_assumptions.accessibility_note: Dose sizing uses calcExpectedReactionRates and does not subtract bound-protein footprints or existing damaged sites; realized support may be lower and must refuse if the Karr floor is not met.
